title: Member Standing Step Added to the Allowance Rate
content:
# Counter Card: The Member Standing Step on the Allowance Rate

A step is added to the allowance rate on a work order of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service where the customer holds a membership of the Belrose Circle Membership Programme. It is read from that membership: how the membership stands, and the qualifying workshop spend booked to it over the twelve months to the handling date.

| The membership records show | Step added to the allowance rate |
|---|---|
| The membership stands active and the qualifying workshop spend booked to it over the twelve months to the handling date reaches 1200 USD | the high member step, 6 percent |
| The membership stands active and that spend falls below 1200 USD | the standing member step, 3 percent |
| Any other case | no step is added on this ground |

**Clause.** Where the membership stands active and the qualifying workshop spend booked to it over the twelve months to the handling date reaches the programme's workshop spend threshold of 1200 USD, the high member step of 6 percent is added to the allowance rate; where the membership stands active and that spend falls below the threshold, the standing member step of 3 percent is added. In any other case no step is added on this ground.

**On the spend.** What is counted is the qualifying spend booked to the membership over the twelve months running back from the handling date on entries earned on workshop service. Spend reaching the threshold exactly — 1200 USD — satisfies the first clause, since the clause asks whether the spend reaches it. Where the membership does not stand active, neither step is added however large the spend.

**Hypothetical readings.** A membership standing active with 1,450.00 USD of qualifying workshop spend in the window carries 6 percent; with 1,200.00 USD exactly, 6 percent; with 900.00 USD, 3 percent; and a membership that has lapsed carries no step on this ground whatever the spend.
